mapper.insert: insert into biz_wallet_log ( member_id, currency, biz_type, biz_id, amount, available_before, available_after, frozen_before, frozen_after, remark, create_time ) values ( #{memberId}, #{currency}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{amount}, #{availableBefore}, #{availableAfter}, #{frozenBefore}, #{frozenAfter}, #{remark}, sysdate() )
